user.title: Virtual Gas Meter
user.description: Estimates gas use from the heating power (%) of your thermostatic valves or heating zones (any brand, e.g. tado X; model m³ = a·days + k·Σ%·h). Enter the last real meter reading. a and k are only rough starting points: k is refined automatically from your readings.

data.reading_date: Date and time of the last reading

data_description.sensors: Any number of sensors with unit %, e.g. sensor.zone_1_heating_power.
data_description.reading_date: Local date and time when you read the meter.

error.date_in_future: The reading date is in the future
error.invalid_k: k must be greater than zero
error.not_percent: All selected sensors must have unit of measurement %

abort.already_configured: The virtual meter is already configured
abort.single_instance_allowed: The virtual meter is already configured

init.title: Virtual Gas Meter options
init.description: Changing a or k overwrites the current values (including refitted ones).

data.auto_k: Refit k automatically on every new reading
data.fix_a: Keep a fixed (otherwise refit a too)

error.invalid_k: k must be greater than zero
error.not_percent: All selected sensors must have unit of measurement %

reading_too_old.message: The reading date ({date}) must be after the last reading ({last})

reading_in_future.message: The reading date ({date}) is in the future

reading_too_low.message: The reading {value} m³ is lower than the last reading {last} m³

not_loaded.message: Virtual Gas Meter is not configured or not loaded

no_pending_reading.message: Enter a value in 'New meter reading' first

register_reading.name: Register reading
register_reading.description: Registers a real meter reading: closes the interval, realigns the meter and (if enabled) refits k.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date and time of the reading (default: now)

delete_reading.name: Delete reading
delete_reading.description: Deletes a reading (by date); its interval is merged into the next one.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date (or date and time) of the reading to delete

recalculate.name: Recalculate coefficients
recalculate.description: Refits k (and a, if not fixed) by least squares over all included intervals.
